# ghost/prevo

PReVo (F-Droid): the offline Esperanto dictionary (Plena Ilustrita Vortaro) with translations into dozens of languages. Search a word in your language, open the Esperanto entry and read its translations. No account, no network.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/prevo
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/prevo open_dictionary --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/prevo search --device <serial> --param term=<term>
ghost skill run ghost/prevo open_entry --device <serial> --param term=<term>
ghost skill run ghost/prevo get_entry --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/prevo back_to_search --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_dictionary`: Open the Esperanto dictionary app
- `search`: Search the Esperanto dictionary for water
- `open_entry`: What is cat in Esperanto?
- `get_entry`: Show the French translation of this word
- `back_to_search`: Go back to the dictionary search
